entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be monitored or recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Customer Service'.
Customer Service.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not what I was looking for. My order number is VF7781-B.

I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up your order... VF7781-B. Okay, I see it. The VeloBand Pulse, delivered 14 days ago. Not a problem at all, you're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, perfect! That's a relief. I was worried I might have missed the deadline. Great, so how do I get the shipping label?
Of course. Let me just generate that for you... just one moment... Hmm. Actually, sir, my apologies, I need to correct something I just said. I'm seeing an alert here in your file.
An alert? What do you mean?

It seems I was mistaken. I was quoting our standard policy for apparel. For high-tech electronics like the VeloBand Pulse, we have a strict 10-day return window. It looks like you're on day 14, so it's outside the eligible period.
Excuse me? But **you just said** it was 90 days. Are you kidding me right now? I wouldn't have been so relieved if I knew that.
I understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the miscommunication. That was my error. The system simply won't let me generate a return label for this item after 10 days.

This is completely unacceptable. You **promised me** I was within the window! This is a **recorded line**, right? You can't just tell me one thing and then completely change the story. This feels like a total **bait and switch**!

You are absolutely right to be upset, and I take full responsibility for giving you the incorrect information. That was my mistake, and I am truly sorry for the confusion it caused. While my system is locked for the return, what I can do to make up for my error is offer you a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account.
Fifty dollars? So I'm stuck with a heart rate monitor I don't want, and you're offering me a credit to spend even more money here?

I understand. The credit is our way of apologizing for the frustrating experience I created. It's the maximum I can offer for my mistake, and you can use it on any future purchase, from jerseys to gear, with no expiration. It's a sincere apology for my oversight.
Sigh... Fine. It's better than nothing, I suppose. At least you're owning the mistake. Go ahead and add the credit.

Thank you for your understanding. I've just applied the $50 VeloFit credit to your account. You'll receive an email confirmation in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you for sorting it out, Alex. I do appreciate you making it right.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
